subject: application_plan
summary: W2 ApplicationPlan correctly applies standard OpenAPI + OCL for insufficient-stock reserve failure (named InsufficientStockError; no hold; stock unchanged), defers formal with X8 / no concurrency_safety rationale, and explicitly preserves W1 authorized-reserve paths on shared SoT. Density is not thinned despite existing W1 InsufficientStockError hooks. Lint minors (Brief 'sufficient', WorkPlan touches overlap) do not remove checkability.

findings.detail: lint: ambiguous phrase 'sufficient' in scope text
lint: overlapping touches on shared OpenAPI/OCL/src across W2–W5; serialize waves (W2 after W1 already required)

W1 already exposes InsufficientStockError hooks in OpenAPI/OCL/impl/tests; plan correctly keeps status apply at standard rather than skip, but downstream apply-api/apply-dbc must elevate no-hold / unchanged-stock as first-class W2 checkable properties—not treat existing hooks as done and no-op.

Slice scopes insufficient-stock failure on shared POST /reservations + Reservation::reserve only; unauthorized (W3) and release/expire (W4/W5) remain later items—acceptable isolation while R6/SC6 lifecycle completeness waits on those waves.
